Ownership
Ownership at Safari Beach is unlike any other resort in the Okanagan. A one of a kind location with 400 feet of waterfront.
Read More
We have the perfect vacation destination waiting for you!
Safari Beach Resort is located on the shore of beautiful Lake Osoyoos, the warmest lake in Canada. This is THE place to relax and enjoy the sunny South Okanagan. Our condominium resort offers a memorable experience, ideal for family vacations, reunions, and getaways. We have over 400 feet of private sandy beach, two outdoor swimming pools, boat moorage, lawn area, gas barbeques, and a fire pit. All of our fully furnished condo units have an individual outside furnished area to enjoy the spectacular lake, vineyard and surrounding mountain views.
Conveniently located shops and restaurants are within walking distance and championship golf courses, water park and wineries are only minutes away.
Your host Paul Scanlon and his team will ensure you experience an memorable stay with us.
